info.text:
The euro launched in 1999 and today more than 357 million people in 21 countries use it. This video explains why Europe built one money, why sharing one interest rate without a shared budget makes it so hard to run, how the Greek debt crisis nearly broke it until Mario Draghi's 'whatever it takes' speech in July 2012, and how the euro-dollar exchange rate reaches American travelers, importers and investors.

News and education, not financial advice.
